<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|240|THE GOSPEL|CHA. VII.}}</noinclude>{{hwe|ueiled,|marueiled,}} saying, Hovv doth this man knovv letters, vvhereas he hath not learned? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=16}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=17}}† If any man {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The way to come to knovv the truth, is to liue wel.}}∷ vvil doe the vvil of him, he shal vnderstand of the doctrine vvhether it be of God, or I speake of my self. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=18}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ It is spoken of Antichrist specially, and it is true in al Heretikes. ''August. tract. 29. in Euang. Io''.}}∷ He that speaketh of him self, seeketh his ovvne glorie. But he that seeketh the glorie of him that sent him, he is true, and iniustice in him there is not. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=19}}† Did not Moyses giue you the lavv, and none of you doeth the lavv? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=20}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 5, 18.''}}* VVhy seeke you to kil me? The multitude ansvvered, and said, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ No maruel, vvhen these speake thus to Christ him self, if Heretikes call his vicar Antichrist.}}∷ Thou hast a deuil, who seeketh to kil thee? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=21}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered, and said to them, One vvorke I haue done: and you doe al marueil. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=22}}† Therfore {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Lev. 12, 3.''}}* Moyses gaue you circuncision: not that it is of Moyses, but {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 17, 10.''}}* of the fathers, and in the Sabboth you circuncise a man. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=23}}† If a man receiue circuncision in the Sabboth, that the lavv of Moyses be not broken: are you angrie at me because I haue healed a man vvholy in the Sabboth? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=24}}† Iudge not according to the face, but iudge iust iudgement.

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=25}}† Certaine therfore of Hierusalem said, Is not this he vvhom they seeke to kil? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=26}}† And behold, he speaketh openly, and they say nothing to him. Haue the Princes knovven in deede that this is {{sc|Christ}}? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=27}}† But this man vve knovv whence he is. But vvhen {{sc|Christ}} commeth, no man knovveth vvhence he is. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=28}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore cried in the temple teaching, and saying, Both me you doe knovv, and vvhence I am you knovv. And of my self I am not come, but he is true that sent me, vvhom you knovv not. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=29}}† I knovv him, because I am of him, and he sent me. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=30}}† They sought therfore to apprehend him: and no man laide handes vpon him, because his houre vvas not yet come. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=31}}† But of the multitude many beleeued in him, ⊣ and said, {{sc|Christ}} vvhen he commeth, shal he doe more signes then these vvhich this man doeth? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=32}}† The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things touching him: and the {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''`cheef Priests''}}`Princes' and Pharisees sent ministers to apprehend him. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=33}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Munday in Passion weeke.}}{{sc|Iesvs}} therfore said to them, Yet a litle time I am vvith you: and I goe to him that sent me. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=34}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 13, 33.''}}* You seeke me, and shal not finde: and vvhere I am, you can not come. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=35}}† The Ievves therfore said among them selues, VVhither vvil this man goe, that vve shal not finde him? VVil he goe into the dispersion of the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=36}}† VVhat is this saying that he hath said, You shal seeke me, and shal<noinclude>{{rh|||not}}</noinclude>
